act_title: The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
title: Adjournment of enquiry.–The Collector may, for any cause he thinks fit, from time to time
text:
34. Adjournment of enquiry.–The Collector may, for any cause he thinks fit, from time to time

adjourn the enquiry to a day to be fixed by him.
